I caught a few rainbow trouts and I would like to ask how Mrs. Fisher is preparing them to eat.
Mrs. Fisher: Good ol’ ‘bows, huh. They are good fish. Easy to catch and tasty.
Mrs. Fisher: I usually filet the fish and remove the skin. Eating it whole after cleaning and descaling is also alright, but remember to always remove the guts.
Mrs. Fisher: You don’t need any fancy ingredients to prepare a meal out of them.I just put some salt and lemon on them and fry them in a pan with butter until they have a nice golden color.
Mrs. Fisher: You can prepare some veggies if you want, but usually I’m too lazy for that.
You: That’s quite a simple dish.
Mrs. Fisher: These fish taste good on their own, there’s no reason to overdo it.
